planSteps.description: In Kitchen view, click the Sound / Notification bell button in the toolbar
Notification Settings modal opens with frosted blur backdrop and 4 distinct sound preset options (Cheerful, Elegant, Digital, Minimalist)
Click the play button to preview the 'นุ่มนวล หรูหรา (Elegant)' sound preset
Audio synthesizer plays the chime and playing animation indicator activates
Select 'ทันสมัย ดิจิทัล (Digital)' preset and click 'บันทึกการตั้งค่า (Save Settings)'
Modal closes and new sound preference is persisted to local storage
